mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may increase paroxetine levels and risk of serotonergic adverse effects; paroxetine may also potentiate hyponatremia risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and paroxetine efficacy/toxicity during concurrent use; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration during amphotericin B therapy.
